top_choice_rationale: P001 (B048, Melitz and Helpman) is the only awarding proposal on the slate and matches my round-2 preferred configuration. Melitz (2003) introduced selection of heterogeneous firms into exporting and reallocation across firms, a distinct channel for the gains from trade. Over twenty years of firm-level testing have supported its qualitative predictions, and credit divides cleanly between two names (the originating model and the main exporting-versus-FDI extension). The main reservations are the priority of Bernard, Eaton, Jensen and Kortum and the dependence of welfare-gain magnitudes on functional form. A citation limited to the selection and reallocation mechanism handles these adequately, so an award is better than no award. P000 is ranked last because the discovery, maturity and attribution criteria are met well enough to justify a prize. This relies on my own recollection of the literature, not independent verification.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; no documented connection to Melitz or Helpman. Disclosed, not adjudicated: SSE affiliation alongside committee colleagues Dreber Almenberg, Friberg and Strömberg, and my field of market design is not trade.
